summary.zh-TW: 抓住左邊的把手上下拖，其他項目會即時讓位；放開後吸到最近的位置。鍵盤用上下方向鍵也能移動，讀屏軟體會唸出新的位置。
summary.en: Grab the handle and drag up or down; the other items make room as you go, and the row snaps into the nearest slot on release. Arrow keys move it too, and screen readers announce the new position.

text.zh-TW: 整列可以上下拖，但只有抓把手才會開始拖；列上其他地方還是可以點、可以選字。
text.en: The whole row drags vertically, but only the handle starts a drag, so the rest of the row stays clickable and selectable.

text.zh-TW: 拖到哪一格：目前的位置除以每列的高度再四捨五入。格子變了，就更新順序、讓其他列讓位。
text.en: The target slot is the current y divided by row height, rounded. When it changes, the order updates and other rows move aside.

text.zh-TW: 畫面上的位置不直接改 DOM，而是維護一個「順序陣列」，再依陣列把每列移到 slot × 列高。拖曳中不動 DOM，動畫才不會跳。
text.en: Instead of reordering the DOM mid-drag, an order array is updated and each row moves to slot × row height. Leaving the DOM alone keeps the motion smooth.

text.zh-TW: 拖曳一定要有鍵盤替代方案：把手有焦點時用上下鍵一次移一格，並用 aria-live 唸出「第幾個，共幾個」。
text.en: Dragging always needs a keyboard alternative: with the handle focused, arrow keys move one slot and aria-live announces the position.
